test_cases.summary:
Verify unlock submission is blocked if reason is empty
when Unlock popup is opened
test_cases.description:
Feature: Unlock Session – Reason Mandatory Validation

Scenario: Verify unlock submission is blocked if reason is empty

Given Unlock popup is opened
When the user keeps Reason field empty
And clicks Submit
Then the system should block unlock action
And mandatory validation should be shown
test_cases.acceptance:
The system should block unlock action
The behavior should be validated when the user keeps Reason field empty.

test_cases.summary:
Verify session unlocks successfully with valid reason
when Unlock popup is opened
test_cases.description:
Feature: Unlock Session – Successful Unlock

Scenario: Verify session unlocks successfully with valid reason

Given Unlock popup is opened
When the user enters a valid unlock reason
And clicks Submit
Then the session should be unlocked successfully
And session state should change to Re-open
test_cases.acceptance:
The session should be unlocked successfully
The behavior should be validated when the user enters a valid unlock reason.

test_cases.summary:
Verify Edit/Delete actions are enabled after session unlock
when the session was locked and then unlocked successfully
test_cases.description:
Feature: Unlock Session – Actions Enabled After Unlock

Scenario: Verify Edit/Delete actions are enabled after session unlock

Given the session was locked and then unlocked successfully
When the user views Actions column for that session
Then Edit and Delete actions should become enabled
test_cases.acceptance:
Edit and Delete actions should become enabled
The behavior should be validated when the user views Actions column for that session.

test_cases.summary:
Verify session remains locked when user cancels unlock popup
when Unlock popup is opened
test_cases.description:
Feature: Unlock Session – Cancel Does Not Unlock Session

Scenario: Verify session remains locked when user cancels unlock popup

Given Unlock popup is opened
When the user enters a reason
And clicks Cancel
Then the popup should close
And the session should remain locked
test_cases.acceptance:
The popup should close
The behavior should be validated when the user enters a reason.

test_cases.summary:
Verify unauthorized user cannot unlock session
when a session is locked
test_cases.description:
Feature: Unlock Session – Only Authorized Users Can Unlock

Scenario: Verify unauthorized user cannot unlock session

Given a session is locked
And the logged-in user does not have Lock permission
When the user tries to unlock the session
Then the system should block the unlock action
And session should remain locked
test_cases.acceptance:
The system should block the unlock action
The behavior should be validated when the user tries to unlock the session.

test_cases.summary:
Verify unlock reason is stored for audit and visible in history/tooltip if available
when the session is unlocked with a reason
test_cases.description:
Feature: Unlock Session – Unlock Reason Stored

Scenario: Verify unlock reason is stored for audit and visible in history/tooltip if available

Given the session is unlocked with a reason
When the user checks lock/unlock info (tooltip/log if available)
Then the unlock reason should be recorded correctly
test_cases.acceptance:
The unlock reason should be recorded correctly
The behavior should be validated when the user checks lock/unlock info (tooltip/log if available).

test_cases.summary:
Verify lock icon is visible but disabled when user belongs to group but lacks lock permission
when the user is assigned to the project/session group
test_cases.description:
Feature: Lock Icon – Disabled Without Lock Permission

Scenario: Verify lock icon is visible but disabled when user belongs to group but lacks lock permission

Given the user is assigned to the project/session group
And the user role does not have Lock permission enabled
When the user opens Data Labelling Session list page
Then the Lock icon should be visible
And it should be greyed out and non-clickable
test_cases.acceptance:
The Lock icon should be visible
The behavior should be validated when the user opens Data Labelling Session list page.

test_cases.summary:
Verify clicking disabled lock icon does not open popup
when lock icon is displayed in disabled state
test_cases.description:
Feature: Lock Icon – Click Ignored in Disabled State

Scenario: Verify clicking disabled lock icon does not open popup

Given lock icon is displayed in disabled state
When the user clicks the disabled Lock icon
Then Lock popup should not open
And no action should be performed
test_cases.acceptance:
Lock popup should not open
The behavior should be validated when the user clicks the disabled Lock icon.

test_cases.summary:
Verify tooltip message indicates permission missing
when lock icon is disabled
test_cases.description:
Feature: Lock Icon – Tooltip for Disabled State (If Available)

Scenario: Verify tooltip message indicates permission missing

Given lock icon is disabled
When the user hovers over the lock icon
Then tooltip should indicate lock permission is required (if tooltip is implemented)
test_cases.acceptance:
Tooltip should indicate lock permission is required (if tooltip is implemented)
The behavior should be validated when the user hovers over the lock icon.

test_cases.summary:
Verify disabled lock icon becomes enabled after Lock permission is granted
when the user is in the group but lock permission is disabled initially
test_cases.description:
Feature: Lock Icon – Enabled After Permission Granted

Scenario: Verify disabled lock icon becomes enabled after Lock permission is granted

Given the user is in the group but lock permission is disabled initially
When admin enables Lock permission for the user role
And the user refreshes or re-login
Then the lock icon should become enabled and clickable
test_cases.acceptance:
The lock icon should become enabled and clickable
The behavior should be validated when admin enables Lock permission for the user role.

test_cases.summary:
Verify user cannot lock session via API even if icon is visible disabled
when the user belongs to the group but lacks Lock permission
test_cases.description:
Feature: Lock Action – Blocked Without Permission Even If Visible

Scenario: Verify user cannot lock session via API even if icon is visible disabled

Given the user belongs to the group but lacks Lock permission
When the user attempts lock action through direct request/API call
Then the system should reject the request
And session should remain unlocked
test_cases.acceptance:
The system should reject the request
The behavior should be validated when the user attempts lock action through direct request/API call.

test_cases.summary:
Verify backend rejects update request for locked session
when a session is locked successfully
test_cases.description:
Feature: Locked Session – Backend Blocks Edit API

Scenario: Verify backend rejects update request for locked session

Given a session is locked successfully
When the user attempts to update session details using direct request/API (bypass UI)
Then the system should reject the request
And return access denied response
test_cases.acceptance:
The system should reject the request
The behavior should be validated when the user attempts to update session details using direct request/API (bypass UI).

when a session is locked successfully
test_cases.description:
Feature: Locked Session – Backend Blocks Delete API

Scenario: Verify backend rejects delete request for locked session

Given a session is locked successfully
When the user attempts to delete session using direct request/API call
Then the system should reject the request
And return access denied response
test_cases.acceptance:
The system should reject the request
The behavior should be validated when the user attempts to delete session using direct request/API call.

test_cases.summary:
Verify backend rejects session status update when session is locked
when a session is locked
test_cases.description:
Feature: Locked Session – Backend Blocks Status Change

Scenario: Verify backend rejects session status update when session is locked

Given a session is locked
When the user attempts to change session status through API (Completed → Re-open / In progress)
Then the system should reject the request
And session status should remain unchanged
test_cases.acceptance:
The system should reject the request
The behavior should be validated when the user attempts to change session status through API (Completed â†’ Re-open / In progress).

test_cases.summary:
Verify backend blocks updates to session configuration fields when locked
when a session is locked successfully
test_cases.description:
Feature: Locked Session – Backend Blocks Configuration Update

Scenario: Verify backend blocks updates to session configuration fields when locked

Given a session is locked successfully
When the user attempts to update session config fields (labels, assignees, reviewers, approval levels) using API
Then the system should reject the update request
And no changes should be saved
test_cases.acceptance:
The system should reject the update request
The behavior should be validated when the user attempts to update session config fields (labels, assignees, reviewers, approval levels) using API.
